newsitem.title: USA: Sunset Financial comfortable with forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Sunset Financial comfortable with forecasts.

text.p: Sunset Financial Corp president and chief executive officer Tad Lowrey said he was comfortable with analyst earnings estimates of $0.61 per share for the third quarter, and $2.59 for fiscal 1996.
"I'm comfortable with those numbers, however, that level may vary with fluctuations in loan loss provisions," Lowrey told Reuters during the Western League of Savings Institutions' annual meeting.

"We still have one of the lowest levels of delinquencies in the region, but that number is creeping up. If it goes up again in the third quarter, we may not hit that earnings target. But if they go down, we might beat that target."

Sunset Financial nearly tripled its earnings to $4.3 million in the first quarter, compared with $1.6 million in the year-ago period. In the second quarter it earned $3 million or $0.59 cents a share, up from $1.3 million or $0.27 per share in the year-ago period.
